name: Heroku Platform Credits for GitHub Students
benefit: US$312 total in Heroku platform credits, applied at a maximum of US$13 each month for 24 months.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack participants must apply for Heroku's student program.
duration: Twenty-four months; the US$13 monthly allowance does not roll over.
restrictions: Credits exclude third-party add-ons. Monthly charges above US$13 can be billed to the payment card; credits cannot be consumed all at once.
